mission: Node 24 for the web app (owner ask 2026-10-22 05:48Z): Node 20 is EOL and gets no fix for the October 2026 Node security release (Brotli RCE, TLS hostname bypasses, Undici). CI setup-node 20 -> 24, apps/web engines.node 24.x as the one source of truth for Vercel and CI, web Dockerfile node:24-alpine. Collector Playwright image (v1.61.0, bundles its own Node) untouched; its bump goes with the next collector release.

impacts.reason: staging-credential-presence (Railway CLI install) and frontend-build setup-node "20"/20 -> 24. Every other workflow already pins 24. No step, secret or delivery logic changes.
engines.node 24.x; the lockfile root mirrors it (3 lines, no dependency change). Vercel builds and serves staging on Node 24.x from the next deployment; npm warns, not fails, on another major.

FROM node:20-alpine -> node:24-alpine. Kept: CI prod-compose (scripts/prod_verify.sh, docker-compose.prod.yml) and local docker-compose.yml build it. Railway never builds apps/web (docs/railway_staging.md).

impact.deployment_impact: Vercel staging web rebuilds on Node 24.x. No collector rollout, no Railway deployment, no RAW migration, no fleet change. Hand-merged (hold-for-owner).

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json; CI, Vercel and the web image return to Node 20.
recovery.trigger: Vercel staging build fails or the web runtime errors on Node 24, or frontend-build/prod-compose fail after merge.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: Verify staging merge on this hand merge (Vercel READY on the merge, /api/version serves it), then the signed-out web smoke.
